# googleworkspace_role (Data Source)

Looks up a Google Workspace admin role by name via the Admin SDK Directory API.

Use it to resolve built-in role names such as `_GROUPS_ADMIN_ROLE` into the role ID that `googleworkspace_role_assignment` needs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_role" "group_admin" {
  name = "_GROUPS_ADMIN_ROLE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
